Culture / Landscape · Mandalgre, Meghalaya

Mandalgre Cultural Centre

A cultural building spanning a planted valley. The elevated form preserves a continuous landscape beneath, while a linking tower and bridge give access to galleries, research spaces and public programmes.

Location
Mandalgre, Meghalaya
Category

A bridge across the terrain
